exposure: institutional interventions (health education, painless delivery introduction, doula care)
outcome: cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR) rate
average annual growth rate (AAGR) of CDMR
cohort: The study included 131,312 deliveries between 2006 and 2014 from three tertiary-level public hospitals in Wenzhou, China.
finding: Institutional and policy interventions were found to reduce the rate of cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR).
mod_finding: Institutional and policy interventions effectively reduced the rate of cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR).
